name: DevOps incident room
description: Alert -> collect evidence -> propose mitigation -> approve -> verify. Produces an incident timeline, approved change, and verification.

steps.title: Collect evidence for {{incident}}
steps.deliverable: Timeline with logs and metrics references
steps.acceptance: Every timeline entry references a log line, metric, or command output.
steps.instructions: Collect evidence for {{incident}}: logs, metrics, recent changes. Build a timestamped timeline. Read-only.

steps.title: Propose mitigation for {{incident}}
steps.acceptance: Proposal names exact commands/changes and their rollback.
steps.instructions: Propose a mitigation for {{incident}} with exact steps and rollback. Do not apply it.

steps.title: Approve mitigation for {{incident}}
steps.instructions: Review the proposal for {{incident}} and approve or deny.

steps.title: Apply mitigation for {{incident}}
steps.acceptance: Only the approved steps were executed.
steps.instructions: Apply the approved mitigation for {{incident}} exactly as approved. Record output.

steps.title: Verify recovery from {{incident}}
steps.acceptance: Recovery shown by the same metrics/logs used for detection.
steps.instructions: Verify the mitigation for {{incident}} using the original evidence sources.
